items.label: 【Includes Precision Stylus Pen
items.value: Unleash Your Creativity】Laptop computer 2-in-1 8100y transform your ideas into digital masterpieces. This win11 tablet comes complete with a high-precision Stylus Pen, designed for natural writing and drawing. Whether you're sketching, annotating documents, or taking class notes, enjoy a fluid and responsive experience that puts true creative power in your hands. The perfect tool for artists, designers, and students.

items: 【Powerful 12GB RAM & 256GB SSD for Flawless Workflow】Never let lag interrupt your creative flow. The massive 12GB RAM ensures you can run demanding design software, keep dozens of reference images open, and multitask between apps without any slowdown. This touchscreen tablet PC combined with a swift 256GB SSD for fast boot times and ample storage, you have a seamless digital canvas for all your projects and inspiration.

【Vibrant 10.1" HD Touchscreen & Premium Metal Build】See your creations come to life on a brilliant display. The 10.1-inch HD (1280x800) In-Cell touchscreen tablets offers sharp details and vibrant colors, providing an exceptional visual experience for both creation and consumption. Housed in a sleek, durable all-metal chassis, it feels premium and robust, making it a stylish and portable companion for your on-the-go creativity.

【Full-Function Type-C & Desktop-Grade Connectivity】Expand your studio anywhere. Turn this portable 2-in-1 tablet into a powerful workstation. The Full-Function Type-C port allows for data, video, and charging. Connect to a large monitor via microHDMI for a dual-screen setup, transfer files rapidly with USB 3.0, and use the 3.5mm audio jack for immersive listening. Professional-grade connectivity is now in the palm of your hand.

【Complete Win 11 Tablet for Learning & Entertainment】Your all-in-one digital hub for work and play. This lightweight tablet PC pre-installed with Genuine Win 11, this device gives you the full power of a computer in a tablet's form factor. Use the front and rear cameras for video calls, enjoy long battery life for a full day of classes or sketching sessions, and unwind with your favorite movies and music on the powerful dual speakers.
